title: Lime Green Account: Fee Waivers and Balance Requirements
summary: This document explains Lime Green Account pricing and balance rules: the monthly maintenance fee is $25.00, waived when your balance is at or above $15,000 during the evaluation period. It also sets a $5,000 end-of-day minimum balance requirement and notes a $0.00 overdraft fee plus guidance to avoid negative balances.
